summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py, rewired the other modules to it (public functions kept, OverflowError/OSError crashes preserved through errors.native), added tests/test_timeparse.py; existing tests pass. Quirks kept as-is: tickets read offset-less times as UTC while escalations use the site zone, roster 2-digit years and negative years map into 20xx, and 24:00 is only valid in roster.
